structs.description: Shared group mailbox epoch transition frame: the cashweb-registry 'G_meta'/'G_epoch' store value and the optional CBOR body of PUT /groups/:group_id/epochs. Each field is text or bytes (bytes are read as hex); unknown keys are ignored.

Sealed-sender group message: the optional CBOR body of PUT /groups/:group_id/messages. Each field is text or bytes (bytes are read as hex); unknown keys are ignored. 'payment' is the group-write-payment that pays the hosting relay for this write; the relay requires it for every new write and never stores it in the message row. It may be absent on a retry of a write the relay already accepted: the relay answers such a retry with the original receipt before it looks at any payment.

Payment carried by a group write (group-message-envelope 'payment'): one signed raw EVM transaction paying the hosting relay's configured payee at least its price, on 'network' (a canonical chain identifier from docs/protocol/chains/v1.json). Its calldata commits to the hosting relay, group, epoch and the envelope's signing digest. 'raw-transaction' is bytes (or hex text).
